implementation_defaults.e4_smote_neighbors: min(5,n_target-1), unsupported below two target rows
implementation_defaults.e5_corruption: only fitting rows; clean tuning/calibration/test; clean-selected hyperparameters frozen
implementation_defaults.e6_weight_selection: one global simplex vector per repetition, tuning balanced accuracy only
